newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSI Services considers China-play stock index.
newsitem.headline: HSI Services considers China-play stock index.

text.p: HSI Services Ltd, the keeper of Hong Kong's blue-chip Hang Seng Index, said on Monday it was considering compiling an index of red chips or China-concept stocks due to market demand for China plays.
"Based on that kind of market demand, we are now thinking about a new index," an HSI Services spokesman said.
But he said that studies were at a preliminary stage and HSI Services had not yet decided which stocks to put into the index.
"We are studying the possibility. Even the definition has not yet been finalised," the spokesman said.
Red chips are Hong Kong incorporated firms with strong China ties.
